latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Add Music to Video Online Free.

- Instantly add background music to your videos online without downloading software.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; the service overlays music and exports in ~30-60 seconds.
- Automatic handling of session setup, authentication, and cloud GPU-based video rendering.
- Supports direct chat interaction for video uploads and editing commands.
- Integrated error handling for tokens, session, credits, file support, and export issues.
- Streamlined for social media creators and users who need fast, no-fuss video music editing.
